title: VISUAL CLASSIFICATION VIA DESCRIPTION FROM LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification accuracy on a custom challenge set of wedding images from diverse cultures (Western African, Chinese, Japanese, and Northern Indian) to measure Western-centric bias. The study measures how often models fail to recognize non-Western weddings and tests mitigation by editing textual descriptors to include culturally diverse clothing (e.g., substituting 'tuxedo' with 'dashiki' or 'kimono').
